title: Fix RecipesFolderStore iOS bookmark APIs
description: RecipesFolderStore.swift uses .withSecurityScope in both URL.bookmarkData(options:) and URL(resolvingBookmarkData:options:) calls, which are unavailable on iOS. Replace with bare bookmark APIs: remove options parameter from bookmarkData() call and use [] or omit options in resolvingBookmarkData. startAccessingSecurityScopedResource() call is fine to keep as it is iOS-compatible.
acceptance_criteria: RecipesFolderStore.swift compiles without error on iOS Simulator target
.withSecurityScope is not referenced in any iOS build path
folderURL is correctly set/cleared after folder selection on iOS
